headlineOfDay: Democrats win both chambers of Congress in a historic midterm rout, driving a Wall Street rally and a sharp fall in oil on hopes of an end to the Iran war.

markets.summary: US stocks rallied strongly, with the Dow up about 3% and the S&P 500 up 1.6%, after Democrats swept the midterms and investors bet on a divided Washington producing fewer policy shocks. The FTSE 100 and Euro Stoxx 50 gained around 2%, while oil slid and the 10-year Treasury yield eased. Data-centre and power-related stocks such as Vistra and Datadog were hit by worries that Democratic control could slow the AI build-out.
